conclusions: Material transfer rejects a universal fixed minimum dimension.
Targeted placement is robust at dimension eight across the six prospectively selected materials, but dimension-four placement has a B05 counterexample.
Higher dimension can trade bottom-flux/profile improvement against slightly worse cumulative-exchange/storage fidelity on B02 and B16.
Same-partition CoRichards decomposition is now the authorized next gate; no partition retuning or closure fitting is authorized.
